title: Community Health II: Main Exam, 1 April 2021
programme: Diploma in Clinical Medicine, Diploma in Health Record and Information Technology, Diploma in Community Oral Health
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

items.text: Explain the meaning of the following terms used in epidemiology.
Describe the differences between clinical focus (clinician) and epidemiological focus (epidemiologist).
If you want to know the number of people in your ward who are properly using latrines, which method of data collection would be appropriate? And why?
As an epidemiologist explain the relationship between environment, host and the agent.
Outline the Common Characteristics of Communicable Diseases.
Explain how you would control rodents in a village community.

You have been posted to Naivasha Sub-County as a Sub-County Epidemiologist. A group of Community Health students have come to your office and their supervisor requests you to share your knowledge and experience in disease outbreak investigations. Highlight the main procedures of conducting a disease outbreak investigation.
Explain the difference between Community diagnosis and Clinical diagnosis.
Using examples explain at least FIVE types of Non-Probability Sampling.

programmes: Diploma in Health Records and Information Technology
